metadata.scope: Step 6, SetA, time 0, 20 instances x 10 runs
metadata.objective: MLU: first component of the lexicographically sorted normalized arc-load vector; smaller is better
metadata.variance: sample_variance uses n-1; population_variance uses n; ± denotes sample_sd, not a confidence interval
metadata.gap: mean of individual max(0, 1 - lower_bound / objective) values; stored as a fraction
metadata.timing: All times in seconds. cpu_time_seconds sums elapsed optimize! calls, not OS CPU time. wall_time_seconds is runner wall time; process_wall_seconds includes process startup.
metadata.certification: Original runner numerical certificates retained; feasible solutions independently audited. This package does not independently prove dual bounds.
metadata.no_pooled_objective: Objectives from different instances are not pooled into a single performance mean.
